svg.title: Option A: Non-Destructive 16-Pin Sumitomo Adapter Wiring (LilyGo T-2CAN & Nissan Leaf ZE1 TCU)
svg.text: Option A (Recommended): Non-Destructive 16-Pin Adapter Harness — LilyGo T-2CAN
All connector pinouts shown from WIRE-SIDE VIEW (looking into wire-entry back of connector, lock tab on top — matches tcu_pins.jpg).
2. CAR SIDE (Behind Glovebox — No Factory Wires Cut)
CAN transceiver; usually works without it too).
• +12V (Red, 3 ends): Male Pin 1 + loop to Male Pin 9 + via 2A Inline Fuse to 12V->USB (+)
• GND (Black, 4 ends): Male Pin 2 + loop to Male Pin 10 + 12V->USB (-) + LilyGo SGNDB
• IT-CAN: Male Pin 3 -> LilyGo CANHB | Male Pin 4 -> LilyGo CANLB
• Why loop Pins 1->9 & 2->10? Routes +12V & GND back to the factory TCU so the car's hands-free
microphone keeps working, without cutting or splicing any original car wires!
Original 40-Pin Nissan TCU Connector — Wire-Side View
(Plugs back into original TCU so hands-free microphone stays powered)
Nissan Leaf ZE1 40-Pin TCU Reference & Car-Side Pin Mapping:
• TCU #1 (White, +12V BAT) : Unpin OEM wire -> 16-pin Fem #1 | Return wire: Fem #9 -> TCU #1
• TCU #28 (Black, GND) : Unpin OEM wire -> 16-pin Fem #2 | Return wire: Fem #10 -> TCU #28
• TCU #6 (Sky Blue, CAN-H) : Unpin OEM wire -> 16-pin Fem #3 | Leave TCU #6 socket EMPTY
• TCU #7 (Violet, CAN-L) : Unpin OEM wire -> 16-pin Fem #4 | Leave TCU #7 socket EMPTY
• Terminal compatibility: NH .025" female pins from the 16-pin kit fit directly into TCU #1 & #28.
